reviewerOrPass: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Started from the adopted VU regulations and rebuilt 180 EC using the annual group menus and exact credits. Rechecked each of the two restricted options, the four project entries, Article 9.1 and the exact individual thesis and intervention evaluation entries. Then reread the current workbook course contributions and requirements against the repaired plans, selected display fields and alignment.
findings: The adopted 2026–2027 OER and annual VU study guide agree on a full-time Dutch-taught 180 EC degree with no formal route. The first year has ten 6 EC units. The second year has eight fixed units and two 6 EC choices. The OER annual timetable and the Study Guide data place Beyond Gender Inequalities and AI & Society first in their respective menus; the exact module entries confirm both selections. Year three consists of 30 EC open study, 6 EC intervention evaluation, 6 EC philosophy of science and an 18 EC individual thesis. The 0 EC language test and three mentorship entries add no credits.

OER Article 9.1 requires participation in statistics before Big Data and in Big Data before Network and Social Media Analysis. Intervention evaluation requires passing statistics and Social Inequality 2 and participating in Interpretive Research. The thesis requires 90 EC from Years 1–2 and participation in intervention evaluation. The exact thesis description confirms a supervised individual research project. The Dutch test or remediation gates the Project 1 grade. Article 12.1 allows approved courses, a minor, internship or study abroad, with level and approval conditions. The four projects involve external partners and distinct policy, research, social enterprise and consultancy roles.

Both plans retain the five sociology courses and three shared empirical-methods courses. Term swaps keep the economics and rhetoric or neural-network courses in available terms. AI Ethics supplies direct fairness, privacy and accountability content and replaces the more peripheral consumer-marketing course. Econometrics contributes causal estimation to intervention evaluation. Neither option supplies a dedicated social-network methods sequence, formal partner projects or the compulsory 18 EC thesis.
